# P35.34 — Run telemetry + the SIG-INGEST-004 binding-version test

**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/312_P35.34__run-telemetry-and-binding-version-test.md`
(manifest row **312**, Round 11 / P35, sub-round 11B). Invoked
`live_verification=false` — committed code + fixtures only; **no
staging run, no production mutation, no `ingestion_permitted` flip,
no gate tick, no merge to main**. Requirement stamps:
**SIG-CONF-009** (owner — upstream reconciliation: the upstream's own
count at fetch vs the subjects held after the run; the unexplained
>1 % fail rule binds where the P34.44a/b check machinery reads it —
this row lands the recording surface) · **SIG-INGEST-004** (the
binding-version MUST — the withheld amendment is not applied, G.7.5:
the versions are added to the logical identity, never weakened) ·
**SIG-INGEST-003/005** cited (idempotent stages; re-extraction
preserves the temporal qualifiers) · **PKG-12** (the per-fetch
telemetry design, F5) · **the J4 S-6 rule** (host always; full URL
only under the lane rules) · **P34.44a/b** cited (the `Also:` pair —
the check machinery this row feeds). **Base:**
`r11/P35.33-run-capture-issue-export` · **Gate:** none — the
withheld-amendment posture is recorded, never re-decided.

## The problem

Two binds on one row. (a) `ingest_run_report.per_fetch` landed as a
column in P35.32 with no writer — the run records carried no
per-egress telemetry, and nothing recorded the upstream's own count
at fetch for the SIG-CONF-009 comparison the GQ-19 check reads. (b)
SIG-INGEST-004 requires the claim's logical identity to include
`extractor_version` and `normalizer_version`; the drafted weakening
was withheld (G.7.5), so the MUST stood unimplemented — a better
parser over identical input would silently re-bind onto the same
claim instead of minting a new one.

## What ships

- **Version-bound claim identity** — `sig.claim-payload/2`:
  `evidence.claim_identity.digest_base` gains sealed
  `extractor_version`/`normalizer_version` keys — a supplied seal
  overrides a record-carried value (a forged or stale stamp can never
  out-vote the binding), `None` leaves asserted-origin mints honestly
  unsealed. `PgClaimSink` seals the versions its evidence binding
  writes (the record's declared `extractor_version` — top level or
  the `evidence` map, same precedence as `assertion.py` — else the
  connector's; the connector's `normalizer_version`). Correction,
  recovery and subject-rekey mints seal the *superseded* claim's
  bound versions via `db.claim_sink.bound_versions` (the claim_
  evidence/extraction join) — a corrected row stands on the same
  extraction and dedups identically. `connectors.
  claim_identity_ingest.emitted_claim_digest` + `reconcile_rows`
  take `connector_version` so the emitted-side digest seals the same
  binding the sink's mint does. **New minting only** — no stored row
  is re-minted, recomputed or rewritten (the P35.22 invariant);
  correction paths that locate a row by digest enumerate every scheme
  it could have been minted under (`legacy_row_digest`, unsealed,
  and each version pair the spine's `extraction` records).
- **Per-fetch telemetry (PKG-12)** — `PoliteFetcher.per_fetch` records
  every egress as `{url, kind, status, bytes, fetched_at,
  duration_ms, outcome}` — `kind: content|robots` (the robots.txt
  probe is real egress); `outcome` marks `host_opt_out`,
  `transport_error`, `rights_reservation`, `challenge`; unevidenced
  fields stay absent, never zero-shaped. `FetchRecord.per_fetch`
  carries it into the run record (`to_dict` round-trips), the
  live-run writer stamps it on the success, politeness-refusal and
  completion paths, and the scheduled `RunRow`'s embedded
  `fetch_record` rides it into the report.
- **The report writer** — `ops.run_report.fetch_fields` emits
  `per_fetch` S-6-scrubbed at write: `host` always (credential-
  stripped, IP hosts suppressed), the full scrubbed URL only where
  `interim_lane` resolves `raw-ok`/`derived-only` with the gate
  passed, else `host + path_sha256`; `error_class` re-validates
  against the S-4 vocabulary (`unclassified_error` off-vocab). Rows
  predating telemetry stay NULL — `not_recorded`, never `[]`
  fabricated; a recorded `[]` stays `[]` (a run that issued zero
  egress).
- **The SIG-CONF-009 pair** — `ingest_run_report.upstream_reconciliation`
  (new sqitch change `ingest_run_report_upstream_recon`, plan
  appended after `transparency_views`) carries the
  `sig.upstream-reconciliation/1` object: per-target pairs from
  `document_outcomes` rows declaring an upstream count
  (`upstream_count`/`total_items`/`total_notice_count`/`row_count`/
  `entry_count`) plus a run-level pair vs the execution's recorded
  `records_emitted`. Honesty tokens, never guesses: `not_exposed`
  where the upstream never declared a count, `not_recorded` where the
  held side is absent. `difference_pct` + closed `classification`
  (`in_range` ≤1 % / `explained` — closed reason vocabulary
  `filtered|withheld_rows|pagination_cap|upstream_misreport|
  other:<class>` / `unexplained` — the fail class above 1 % /
  `not_evaluable`). Per-target identifiers pass the same S-6 scrub —
  host + gated url or `path_sha256`, never raw path detail. The
  column is deliberately **not** on `v_transparency_run`'s
  allow-list — it is check-machinery input, not a public field.
- **`eval_gq19`** — `ops.quality` gets the real evaluator (the
  `SEAM_DEFERRALS["GQ-19"]` entry is discharged): measures the
  `unexplained` share over recorded pairs, read-only; a spine without
  the column or with zero evaluated pairs answers `not_evaluable`,
  never a pass. The registry row's note records the landed seam; the
  check stays `mode: report` — enforcement promotion is CONF-01's
  placement decision, not this row's.
- **Idempotent +0** — report inserts keep `ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING`
  over the live/backfill partial uniques; claim identity stays
  digest-keyed; a re-run of either writer adds zero rows.

## Test evidence

- `tests/evidence/test_claim_identity_projection.py` (+4) — the
  projection seals the versions; a differing extractor or normalizer
  version mints a different digest over identical content; a forged
  record-carried seal loses to the caller's; `payload_version`
  declares `sig.claim-payload/2`.
- `tests/connectors/test_claim_identity_ingest.py` (+3) — emitted ==
  stored parity under a bound connector version; declared versions
  (top-level and the `evidence` map) win over the connector default;
  reconcile rows carry the sealed digest.
- `tests/connectors/test_net.py` (+6) — content + robots entries land
  per fetch; transport errors record `outcome: transport_error` with
  status/bytes absent; opt-out, reservation and challenge outcomes
  mark their rows; unevidenced fields absent.
- `tests/ops/test_run_report.py` (+~20) — per-fetch S-6 scrub
  (host + `path_sha256` off-lane, gated full URL on-lane, credential
  params stripped, IP host suppressed, S-4 error vocabulary);
  reconciliation pairs — exact/`in_range` at the 1 % boundary,
  `explained` with each reason class incl. `other:` and the run-level
  quota/budget reasons, `unexplained` >1 %, `not_exposed`/
  `not_recorded` tokens, `not_evaluable`, no-object without run
  evidence; `FetchRecord.to_dict` round-trip; the scheduled-row path
  end to end.
- `tests/ops/test_quality_runner.py` (+1) — `eval_gq19` over a stub
  conn: the unexplained share measures, zero pairs is
  `not_evaluable`, and the SQL issues no writes.
- `tests/db/test_ingest_run_report.py` — the whole-plan sqitch
  deploy+verify harness proves the column + CHECK; the a-row asserts
  `per_fetch` NULL (predated telemetry) and the `not_exposed`
  run-level pair with `subjects_held=4`.
- `tests/db/test_okc_seed_correction.py` (6) —
  `_target_digest_candidates` now enumerates the sealed schemes, so
  the packet locates version-bound targets: applied/idempotent/dry-
  run/scope/compartment all green on real PG.
- `tests/db/test_p31_6_access_edges.py` — the replay test's original
  run mints under the connector's real version (version-bound
  identity: a different minting version legitimately mints anew);
  replay then tops up only the genuinely-new claims and re-runs +0.
- `tests/db/test_partner_entity_refs.py` — expected digests compute
  under the sink's bound versions (same mint path, assert equality).
- `make check` — lint + format + mypy clean; pytest green except the
  four env-armed base-identical reds recorded verbatim on P35.32/
  P35.33's ledgers (`SIG_GCP_PROJECT` OP-07 unset locally; the
  P34.18 handle-list pair driven by the operator's local restricted
  map — `D-P35.3-3`'s recorded class), none touching this row's
  files.

## Honest absences (typed, never fabricated)

- `not_exposed` upstream counts — a source that never declares a
  count at fetch records the token, never a guessed number.
- `not_recorded` held side / pre-telemetry `per_fetch` NULLs — a
  value the record never evidenced stays absent.
- `not_evaluable` — a pair missing either side, a spine without the
  column, a check with zero recorded pairs: all report it, none pass
  vacuously.
- Interim lane basis — `interim_lane` consumes today's rights-record
  fields (`D-P35.31-1`); unresolved sources publish host + path hash
  only. The `public`/lane-class fields are row 313's.
- GQ-19 stays `report` mode — the >1 % unexplained fail binds where
  the enforcement machinery reads it (P34.44a/b / CONF-01), exactly
  the requirement's "once the check is enforced" phrasing.
